WITH RECURSIVE menu AS ( SELECT MENU_SEQ , MENU_CODE , MENU_TITLE , MENU_URL , MENU_PARENT , 0 MENU_LEVEL , SORT_ORDER , CAST(LPAD(SORT_ORDER,5,'0') AS CHAR(200)) AS sort_path , DEL_YN FROM TB_MENU WHERE MENU_CODE = 'ROOT'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.MENU_SEQ , m.MENU_CODE , m.MENU_TITLE , m.MENU_URL , m.MENU_PARENT , menu.MENU_LEVEL + 1 MENU_LEVEL , m.SORT_ORDER , CONCAT(menu.sort_path, LPAD(m.SORT_ORDER,5,'0')) , m.DEL_YN FROM TB_MENU m JOIN menu ON m.MENU_PARENT = menu.MENU_CODE ) SELECT MENU_CODE , MENU_TITLE , MENU_URL , MENU_PARENT , MENU_LEVEL , MENU_SEQ , DEL_YN FROM menu WHERE MENU_CODE != 'ROOT' AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY sort_path

WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT MENU_CODE , MENU_TITLE , MENU_PARENT , 0 AS MENU_LEVEL , CAST(LPAD(SORT_ORDER,5,'0') AS CHAR(200)) AS sort_path FROM TB_MENU WHERE MENU_CODE = 'ROOT'
UNION ALL
SELECT m.MENU_CODE, m.MENU_TITLE, m.MENU_PARENT, mt.MENU_LEVEL + 1 , CONCAT(mt.sort_path, LPAD(m.SORT_ORDER,5,'0')) FROM TB_MENU m JOIN menu_tree mt ON m.MENU_PARENT = mt.MENU_CODE WHERE m.DEL_YN = 'N' ) SELECT mt.MENU_CODE, mt.MENU_TITLE, mt.MENU_LEVEL, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MENU c WHERE c.MENU_PARENT = mt.MENU_CODE AND c.DEL_YN = 'N' ) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS MENU_CHILD_YN, mt.MENU_PARENT FROM menu_tree mt ORDER BY mt.sort_path

SELECT MENU_CODE , MENU_SEQ , MENU_TITLE , MENU_URL , MENU_PARENT , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MENU c WHERE c.MENU_PARENT = #{value} AND c.DEL_YN = 'N' ) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS MENU_CHILD_YN , DEL_YN FROM TB_MENU WHERE MENU_CODE = #{value}
